tools.name: get_palisade_agent_resources
tools.description: Where to connect programmatically: the MCP server and its discovery document, the OpenAPI document, the authentication walkthrough, agent instructions and llms.txt.

tools.name: get_palisade_pricing
tools.description: Palisade's published plans and prices: the Free plan's limits, every IT-teams tier by monthly email volume with monthly and annual prices, how MSP and Enterprise pricing works, and where the full table lives.

tools.name: lookup_email_auth_records
tools.description: Read the live DMARC, SPF, DKIM, MX, BIMI, NS or A records of any public domain from DNS, parsed. Use to check whether a domain publishes DMARC and at what policy, or what its SPF record authorizes. DKIM needs a selector.

domain.description: The domain to look up, for example example.com

type.description: Which records to read. Defaults to all.

selector.description: DKIM selector, required when type is dkim

tools.name: search_palisade_site
tools.description: Find Palisade guides, tools, comparisons and product pages by keyword. Returns up to 10 pages with their URL and a one-line description; append .md to a URL for its Markdown twin.

query.description: Words to look for, for example spf permerror
